answer: I fixed it so WARN lines no longer use up the ERROR budget, and `yk check --no-heal -m cli` passes (`RESULT status=SUCCESS`). Each node now gets up to 20 ERROR lines and, separately, 10 WARN lines (each level has its own "suppressed" notice), so the line that failed it is always shown; the change is in `problems.go`, plus a test in `problems_test.go` reproducing the issue's case.
